title: How Hyperbolic Are Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models?
abstract: arXiv:2611.13384v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyperbolic vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a rapidly growing area of research, reporting strong zero-shot performance alongside an interpretable embedding space in which radius orders representations by generality. But how hyperbolic are hyperbolic VLMs in practice? We investigate this at the exponential map, the single operation through which curvature enters an otherwise Euclidean network. We show that across MERU, HyCoCLIP, ARGENT, and PHyCLIP, the exponential map is well approximated by the identity function, i.e., pairwise distances and angles in the pre-map Euclidean space barely change under projection, and removing the map at inference leaves evaluation scores unchanged. Motivated by this observation, we train Euclidean VLMs on CC3M from scratch under the same hierarchy losses. translated_title: 双曲视觉-语言模型到底有多“双曲”？
translated_abstract: 双曲视觉-语言模型（VLM）已成为一个快速发展的研究领域，据报道其具有强大的零样本性能以及一个可解释的嵌入空间——在该空间中，半径按照泛化程度对表示进行排序。但双曲视觉-语言模型在实践中到底有多双曲呢？我们在指数映射上对此进行研究——这是曲率进入原本为欧氏网络的唯一操作。我们表明，在MERU、HyCoCLIP、ARGENT和PHyCLIP这些模型中，指数映射可以被恒等函数很好地近似，即映射前欧氏空间中的成对距离和角度在投影后几乎不变，而在推理时移除该映射后评估分数保持不变。受这一观察的启发，我们在CC3M上使用相同的层次损失从零开始训练欧氏视觉-语言模型。在大约最后90%的训练步骤中，其训练统计量与其双曲对应模型几乎无法区分。
tldr: 研究发现主流双曲视觉-语言模型中的指数映射实际近似于恒等映射，移除它对性能没有影响，且使用相同层次损失训练的纯欧氏模型表现几乎与之无异，说明这些“双曲”模型在实践中几乎并不真正双曲。
en_tdlr: The exponential map in hyperbolic vision-language models is nearly an identity function—removing it leaves evaluation scores unchanged, and Euclidean models trained with the same hierarchy losses are nearly indistinguishable—revealing that these "hyperbolic" models are barely hyperbolic in practice.
